story.title: 'There's no stopping Antonelli' - Hamilton says 2026 F1 title bid is over
story.summary: Lewis Hamilton appeared to give up hope of claiming a record eighth Formula 1 title this year as he said that "there's no stopping" Kimi Antonelli following the championship leader's latest victory at the Spanish Grand Prix.
